compute_sqeuclidean_row_norms: compute the squared euclidean norm of rows in a float32 or float64 array using parallel threads
run_argkmin_nearest_neighbors: run argkmin to find k nearest neighbor indices for each row in X against rows in Y
run_radius_neighbors_search: run radius neighbors search to find all Y rows within a given distance of each X row
run_argkmin_classmode_predict: run argkmin classmode to compute weighted class probabilities for k nearest neighbors
run_radius_neighbors_classmode_predict: run radius neighbors classmode to compute weighted class probabilities within a distance radius
